name: livingpatch
description: Ecological literacy tool for NE Pennsylvania species

scripts.build: npm run build:dataset && cd app && npm run build
scripts.e2e:local: npm run build && npm run e2e
scripts.bundle:app: npm run bundle:packs && cd app && npx vite build
scripts.bundle:single-file: npm run bundle:packs && cd app && VITE_SINGLE_FILE=true npx vite build --outDir dist-single-file && rm -f dist-single-file/favicon.svg
